not_acceptance: No build, test or model execution performed. Static inspection only.
runtime_findings: Immutable complete-input policy is copied into scheduler requests and explicitly forwarded through normal prefill, chunk continuation and inline fallback.
Both arms carry identity and produce one layer-zero policy record per prefill chunk.
Mode conflicts and unsupported enabled server modes reject before model load.
Model entry validates context length/base/range before sequence submission; direct MoE validates active context and selector dependencies.
A singleton long-request tail preserves long policy while using existing singleton dispatch.
No new GPU sync, math, GEMM, cache allocation, cache reset or mutable cross-request selector was added.
scope_limit: Direct model API callers are responsible for reusing the same context across chunks; the implementation does not store and compare request identity across separate ModelSequence calls. HTTP keeps one const context and satisfies the frozen scope.
numeric_contract: Real layer2 router C64/T32 and T1; real expert/shared weights with controlled in-memory router C15/T4/T1 to distinguish legacy3chunks/2singleton versus min-new2chunks/1singleton. BF16 and router equality; routed FP32 differences reported separately. Full input length is a small-fixture policy label, not full model coverage.
protocol_finding: Requested same-prompt output consistency across all three history rounds and both repeated8192 positions because one request per case makes local deterministic flag trivial. Protocol owner is implementing the checker.
